review: Heishou pack Adept Horse Sang is yet another hybrid Rupture ID and this time, he has Tremor as his secondary status effect. To start, he is quite tanky due to his innately high Defense level and HP, on top of having shields, Defense Level Up, and Protection. He has several unique effects that buff his allies, making him a good addition to the team, if not for him being Count Negative therefore preventing the same. However, unlike Sinclair, with whom he was released, Uma Sang has access to Dimensional Shredder E.G.O., allowing him to be Count Positive completely. His Built-in Passive - The Steed’s Houndlike Loyalty, makes him interact with 2 other IDs- Lord Hong Lu and Hierarch Ishmael.
